name: OpenVibe.Tools

site.name: Tools
site.what: More than 160 online tools: converters, downloaders, PDF and image tools, developer utilities and network diagnostics, each on its own address.

liveness.means: the gateway answers HTTP and reports the tool registry, run API and jobs facade counters; it checks nothing else

drains: timers, pollers and job workers stopped: the gateway's catalog, services and satellite pollers and search indexer; the retention timers and job workers of img, audio and docs (open job event streams end); yt's download cleanup

stops taking connections; idle keep-alive connections closed; requests in flight answered with Connection: close and allowed to finish (4 s at most, then cut); open event streams closed (EventSource reconnects)
recent-tool usage flushed to Network (1 s at most)
analytics flushed and closed; jobs store and worker pools closed (running jobs stay running in jobs.db for the next boot); guard closed; the gateway's cutoff store closed
shutdown.note: every Tools process (the gateway, openvibe-tools.service, and the seven satellites) stops through apps/_shared/graceful.js; a stop that passes 5 s exits 1. The units set no TimeoutStopSec (systemd's 90 s default applies)

resumes.what: jobs left running in img, audio and docs jobs.db are re-queued while attempts remain (onRestart requeue), else failed as retryable
unsent tools.job.* events go to OpenVibe.Events
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.user.token_valid_after that were pending during the stop (at least once, deduped by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (60 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

leases.none: no claims: one process owns each app's jobs.db (better-sqlite3, single writer); a job is taken with a compare-and-set (queued → running)

notes: Public at openvibe.tools: 169 tools in 9 families on the gateway (port 4001) and its satellites, catalogue at GET /api/catalog.json (re-served by Network). Asynchronous jobs (Wave 11) run on the img, audio and docs satellites only (POST /api/v1/jobs, GET/DELETE /api/v1/jobs/:id, POST /api/v1/jobs/:id/retry, PUT|DELETE /api/v1/jobs/:id/references/:ref, SSE events, result files); the gateway has no /api/v1/jobs yet. Job results are stored as private Media objects (TOOLS_JOB_RESULTS=media: Tools holds media.object.upload and media.object.read, namespace tools) and job lifecycle events tools.job.created|started|succeeded|failed are published to OpenVibe.Events through an outbox in each satellite's jobs.db (EVENTS_URL set; events.event.publish). The tool registry (ADR-027, tools.tool.read) is served: GET /api/v1/tools[/:id[/schema]] on the gateway, for all 169 tools, and on the img, audio, docs, text, yt, maps and food satellites for their own. Planned (ADR-027): the uniform run API POST /api/v1/tools/:id/run (tools.tool.run; network probes need tools.net.probe), a jobs facade on the gateway, tiered quotas and a pseudonymous abuse log; the legacy /api/process, /api/net/* and /api/dev/* routes keep working with Deprecation and Sunset (2026-12-31) headers. GET /api/ready is truthful on the gateway (it checks every satellite) and on each satellite.
